recipes._notes: Dynamic parameter keys are case-sensitive and must match exactly. Use '<handle>*GEOM*DYNAMIC_PARAMETER GET' to discover parameter names for any geometry. The channel prefix (e.g. '1') from step 1 must be prepended to all subsequent commands for that handle.

create_rectangle.description: Create a new top-level container with a Rectangle geometry

steps.description: Create a new container at the top of the scene tree. Returns a channel-prefixed handle, e.g. '1 #3688'.
Set a human-readable name on the container.
Assign the built-in Rectangle geometry to the container.
Activate the container so it is visible on-air.
Set a geometry parameter. Parameter keys are case-sensitive.

create_rectangle.notes: Discover all parameters for any geometry with: '<channel> <handle>*GEOM*DYNAMIC_PARAMETER GET'

create_circle.description: Create a new top-level container with a Circle geometry

steps.description: Create a new container at the top of the scene tree. Returns a channel-prefixed handle, e.g. '1 #3716'.
Set a human-readable name on the container.
Assign the built-in Circle geometry to the container.
Activate the container so it is visible on-air.
Set a geometry parameter. Parameter keys are case-sensitive.

create_circle.notes: Parameter keys are lowercase ('radius', 'corners') except 'Mode'. Discovered live from Viz Engine 5.3.2.60000 Circle geometry.

rules: All properties tested live — only accessible properties are listed here
Only one texture slot per container tested (UNIT=1)
POSITION, SCALING, CENTER, ROTATION all operate in UV space (0.0–1.0 range)
COMBINE and IMAGE2 work together — assign IMAGE2 first, then set COMBINE mode
ENVIRONMENT SET BLEND uses CONSTANT_COLOR as the blend target color
Always send SET and GET as separate TCP call arrays to get confirmed values

shorthand.assignImageNote: Shorthand that sets both IMAGE and TEXTURE in one command. Use *TEXTURE* properties for fine-tuning after assignment.

properties.description: Returns the internal texture object ID attached to the container
properties.notes: Use this ID to reference the texture object directly

properties.description: Full Hub path of the primary image assigned to this texture slot
properties.notes: Path format is IMAGE*<hub_path> without leading slash

properties.description: Full Hub path of the secondary image for multi-texture combine operations. Used together with COMBINE to blend or mask two images.
properties.notes: Same path format as IMAGE — IMAGE*<hub_path> without leading slash. Works in conjunction with COMBINE to define the blend method between IMAGE (primary) and IMAGE2 (secondary).

properties.description: Filename only of the assigned image (no path)
Enables or disables the texture slot
Controls how the texture tiles when UV coordinates exceed [0,1]
properties.notes: REPEAT tiles the texture; CLAMP stretches the edge pixels

properties.description: Defines the UV coordinate generation method
properties.notes: LINEAR=standard UV from geometry, VERTEX=UV from vertex data, SPHERE=spherical environment mapping, CUBE=cube map environment mapping

properties.description: Controls how the texture color is combined with the material/geometry color
properties.notes: MODULATE=multiply with material color (default), REPLACE=fully replaces material color, DECAL=alpha-blended decal overlay, BLEND=blend with CONSTANT_COLOR, ADD=add texture on top of material color
MIPMAP=mipmapped filtering, best quality (default); LINEAR=simple linear filtering, faster, no mipmaps

properties.description: Rotates the texture around the pivot defined by CENTER (X Y Z Euler degrees)
properties.format: X Y Z — three space-separated floats in degrees
properties.notes: Three space-separated float values for X, Y, Z rotation in degrees

properties.description: UV offset — shifts the texture in U (X) and V (Y) space
properties.format: X Y — two space-separated floats, approx range -1.0 to 1.0

properties.description: UV scale — zooms the texture in U (X) and V (Y) space
properties.format: X Y — two space-separated floats. Default 1 1. Value of 2 2 zooms in 2x

properties.description: Rotation pivot point in UV space (X Y)
properties.format: X Y — two space-separated floats. Default 0 0. Set to 0.5 0.5 for center pivot

properties.description: RGBA constant color used in conjunction with ENVIRONMENT SET BLEND. Defines the constant color that the texture blends with.
properties.format: R G B A — four space-separated floats, each 0.0 to 1.0

properties.description: Controls which channels of the texture are active/displayed
properties.notes: COLOR=RGB channels only, ALPHA=alpha channel only, COLOR_ALPHA=both RGB and alpha (default). RED/GREEN/BLUE/INTENSITY are NOT valid on this engine (return -1)

properties.description: Defines how IMAGE (primary) and IMAGE2 (secondary) are combined in a multi-texture setup. Only meaningful when IMAGE2 is also assigned.
properties.notes: ALPHA=use IMAGE2 alpha to blend between IMAGE and IMAGE2, BLEND=blend IMAGE and IMAGE2 together. NOT valid on this engine: MODULATE, ADD, REPLACE, DECAL, SUBTRACT, MULTIPLY, DOT3, INTERPOLATE, NONE
